videos.title: The Asian Connection
videos.description: Two American expats, Jack and Sam, become the targets of a Southeast Asian gang's vengeance when they unwittingly steal a drug lord's money.

videos.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
videos.description: Richie and Santanico pose as sex traffickers to infiltrate Malvado's food supply, while Sonja forces Seth to kick his drug habit. Meanwhile, Freddie faces off with Sex Machine.

videos.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
videos.description: Kate hunts down Scott in Bethel; Richie and Santanico find themselves deep in the flesh trade; Seth tries to get back on Uncle Eddie's good side.

videos.title: Rebel Without a Crew
videos.description: Bola's new attitude is tested as she encounters more filming hurtles; the cast gets surprise visits from Robert Rodriguez when he drops by their sets to see their work.

videos.title: Ring of Fire
videos.description: Cross-town lovers (Don "The Dragon" Wilson, Maria Ford) fuel the rivalry between Los Angeles kickboxing clubs, leading to a showdown.

videos.description: Los Angeles thugs kidnap a doctor's (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) girlfriend and force him into a kickboxing ring of death.

videos.title: Ring of Fire 3: Lion Strike
videos.description: His son's (Jonathon Wilson) kidnapping pits a doctor (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) against a global underworld.

videos.description: Terrorists reroute a passenger jet from Athens to Beirut, where commandos (Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin) are waiting to negotiate.

videos.description: To avenge his brother's death, a mercenary works undercover as a teacher at a tough high school.

videos.description: A former mercenary (Treat Williams) becomes an undercover professor as he tries to track down the person who attacked an old Army buddy's daughter.

videos.description: An undercover policeman infiltrates a military school's faculty to put a stop to the actions of white supremacists.

videos.description: A U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) returns to Vietnam and fights his way out with his wife, son (Roland Harrah III) and Amerasian orphans.
